findings.title: QML plugin spawns processes or touches files
findings.remediation: Keep process invocations minimal, avoid shells (bash -c), and never run privileged commands from a UI plugin.

findings.title: Installer script does not enable strict error handling
findings.message: no set -e / set -u / pipefail in an installer-like script
findings.remediation: Start installer scripts with set -euo pipefail and check variables before using them in paths.

findings.title: Omarchy plugin marketplace listing
findings.message: listed as omarchycube.controls (unverified); marketplace validated commit 669ef03ebf91; this commit matches the validated snapshot. Marketplace checks are a limited baseline, not a security audit.
findings.remediation: Compare the commit you install with the validated one; `omarchy plugin add` clones upstream HEAD, which is not verification-bound.

findings.title: Omarchy shell plugin manifest validation
findings.message: valid Omarchy plugin manifest 'omarchycube.controls' (kinds: bar-widget). Plugins run as unsandboxed code inside omarchy-shell with the user's full file and process access.
findings.remediation: Run `omarchy plugin validate <folder>` and fix every reported field before publishing.
